name: @chestor/workspace-ui
title: Workspace
description: Canonical workspace shell web component for chestor/workspace.

wippy.description: Renders the canonical workspace shell as <chestor-workspace>. The component discovers installed entry kinds from the registry, lists and navigates the actor-visible component tree, and opens each kind's declared create/manage renderer. It accepts no props or slotted content; navigation and mutations use the authenticated host API, while missing optional entry renderers are surfaced as explicit errors.
